question: Which forms of Skanda are invoked to protect the body and the ten directions?
premises: Skanda is asked to protect the limb or body
The fire-born one is asked to protect in the ten directions
inference: Skanda protects the body and the fire-born one protects in the ten directions.
plain_english: May Skanda protect my body, and may the fire-born one protect me in the ten directions.
